title: Shôsetsuka no jôji 2: Furin ryokô
original_title: 小説家の情事２ 不倫旅行
overview: Koji, a novelist, plans a secret tryst with his young mistress, Asami, hoping to slip away unnoticed by his wife, Michiko. However, Michiko follows him and shows up at the inn. While Koji tries to find a way to enjoy a romantic encounter with Asami behind his wife's back, he discovers that the inn's proprietress, Takako, was actually Asami's high school teacher—and that the two once shared a lesbian relationship. Unaware of this history, Koji schemes to have sex with Takako as well as Asami...
